body:
## Change

F1. Reset effect text scroll only when displayed preview identity changes. Shared panel no longer opens next card midway through prior card's scroll position.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN captured. Parent reviewed reactive identity/node handling; reran 18 related component tests. Parent rebuilt isolated production-component harness, reran real Chromium: scrollTop 240 before card switch, 0 afterward.
V2. Worker boundary/data-cy: 87 passed. Typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Browser proof uses real shared component, not whole application bootstrap. Full repo/browser gates not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(shared-ui): reset effect scroll when preview changes
